data.title: Food & Restaurant — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: food
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Vroom vroom) Let's hit the road, feel the beat, the rhythm flows.

[Hook]
Vamos… Let's go
El viaje… The road trip
¿Qué quieres?… What do you want?
The soup… La sopa
The salad… La ensalada
The coffee… El café
This is how we roll.

[Verse]
Bajo el sol… Under the sun
We sing along, having fun.
Good vibes… Buenas vibras
Music up, the world is ours.
La manzana… The apple
Crunchy and sweet.
El plátano… The banana
A perfect treat.
We laugh and talk, stories unfold,
Friends on the road, stories told.

[Hook]
Vamos… Let's go
El viaje… The road trip
¿Qué quieres?… What do you want?
The soup… La sopa
The salad… La ensalada
The coffee… El café
This is how we roll.

[Verse]
Paramos aquí… We stop right here
At this diner, atmosphere.
Order up, what do we say?
El menú… The menu
Points the way.
Pollo o carne… Chicken or beef
Choices to make, nothing too brief.
La cuenta, por favor… The check, please
Gracias… Thank you
For the company and memories.

[Bridge]
